title: A Survey on Trustworthy Recommender Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing existing literature on fairness quantification metrics (e.g., Demographic Parity, Equal Opportunity, Equalized Odds) and mitigation strategies (pre-processing, in-processing, and post-processing) to address disparate impact and algorithmic discrimination against protected consumer or producer groups.

Reviewing methods and metrics for measuring and mitigating the over-recommendation and disproportionate exposure of frequently interacted items at the expense of less popular or long-tail items (e.g., using Constrained Markov Decision Processes for dynamic fairness).
Reviewing approaches that measure disparities in recommendation quality (evaluated via metrics like F1 and NDCG) between highly active users and inactive users.
